## Code Review Findings Summary

### Standards Axis
- **TypeScript & Build Architecture**: Full type safety under NodeNext resolution, zero compilation errors with `tsc --noEmit`, clean production bundle and DTS generation with `tsup`.
- **Workflow & Routine Conventions**: Adheres to strict GitHub Actions conventions, proper least-privilege token usage (`secrets.GH_PAT || github.token`), anti-loop bot user filters, and Antigravity run session link footers.
- **Template Synchronization**: All additions to `templates/` are perfectly mirrored in `.github/` and validated by invariant test suites.

### Spec Axis (PR #34 Improvements)
- **Formal Attribution & Credits**: Added standard `NOTICE` file formally acknowledging architectural lineage from OpenAI Symphony under Apache-2.0 and added Acknowledgments & Credits section to `README.md`.
- **Automated Upstream Symphony Radar**: Added scheduled weekly GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/symphony-radar.yml` (runs Mondays at 09:00 UTC with `workflow_dispatch` support) and query script `.github/scripts/fetch-symphony-radar.js` with 4-layer evaluation matrix and triage checklist.
- **Orchestration Architecture & Evaluation Framework**: Documented upstream evaluation layers and classification categories in `templates/prompts/ORCHESTRATION.md` and `.github/prompts/ORCHESTRATION.md`.
- **Inward Blocker Dependency Gating**: Updated candidate selection in `templates/prompts/autowork.md` and `.github/prompts/autowork.md` to gate `Blocked by #N` / `Depends on #N` issues until prerequisite blockers merge.
- **Release Please Exclusions**: Excluded automated release PR branches (`release-please--*`) from review contention and triggers in `.github/workflows/trigger-review-routine.yml`, `templates/workflows/trigger-review-routine.yml`, and `peer-review.md`.

### Security Pass
- Minimal permissions declared (`contents: read`, `issues: write` for radar workflow).
- Token usage uses standard secrets fallback (`secrets.GH_PAT || github.token`).
- Zero hardcoded credentials or tokens in source code or template prompts.
